title: traders-net
description: Wealth of units inside small networks (eurisko-study/traders-net). Source: study/V1/grafana in that workspace.

panels.title: Wealth by scale (sum over units) and total income R
panels.description: Cumulative wealth (booked income a*dR/da) summed over every unit at one granularity. Each complete cut should add up to R, the model’s total income (dashed); the gap at a scale is income paid to biases and LayerNorm/softmax leaks. Heads can sum below zero: the attention softmax is not degree-one homogeneous.

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: Every run the exporter sees: study/<ws>/runs/<run>/metrics.csv (id <ws>.<run>) and the live wealth-net seeds (id wealth-net.<tag>, derived from its 100-step snapshots). Rows = checkpoints.

panels.title: Wealth by family: out
panels.description: Cumulative wealth of the readout weights (one per question), split by the family of the question that paid it. Negative = on balance these units pushed the loss up on that family (in-sample books).

panels.title: Wealth by family: head
panels.description: Cumulative wealth of the attention heads, split by the family of the question that paid it. Negative = on balance these units pushed the loss up on that family (in-sample books).

panels.title: Wealth by family: neuron
panels.description: Cumulative wealth of the MLP neurons, split by the family of the question that paid it. Negative = on balance these units pushed the loss up on that family (in-sample books).

panels.title: Wealth by family: comp
panels.description: Cumulative wealth of the components (embeddings, attention/MLP blocks), split by the family of the question that paid it. Negative = on balance these units pushed the loss up on that family (in-sample books).

panels.title: Wealth Gini vs shuffled-label null
panels.description: Gini of positive wealth per scale (0 = equal, 1 = one unit owns everything). Dashed = same run with shuffled labels (S0 panel.py). No null line = the run did not log one; wealth-net has none.

panels.title: Rank churn: 1 - Spearman(wealth now, 1000 steps ago)
panels.description: How much the wealth ranking moved over the last 1000 steps. Cumulative wealth freezes its ranks by construction (the premise says cumulative rank stability is an artefact), so read this with the turnover panel.

panels.title: Income turnover: Spearman(income this window, previous window)
panels.description: Rank correlation of per-unit income between consecutive 100-step windows. Near 1 = the same units keep earning; near 0 = income is noise at that scale.

panels.title: Births, bankruptcies, units in the red
panels.description: Fraction of units with negative cumulative wealth, per scale. births/bankrupt (right axis, counts) appear only in runs with an economy (K1, M8); wealth-net has neither.

panels.title: Conservation residual (fraction of |income|)
panels.description: How far the books leak: |sum of unit revenues at a cut - model income| / |income|, by where the leak enters (total, attention QK, softmax, LayerNorm, other). Near 0 means the wealth of a big trader equals the sum of its parts. Log axis.

panels.title: Exploitation E_C(t) by trader class
panels.description: Best cumulative profit a fixed trader class C makes against the network’s prices (M5 harness). A logical inductor keeps every line sublinear: flat or bending over. A straight rising line means the class exploits the net.

panels.title: Market price per family (mean probability)
panels.description: Mean predicted probability (the market price) on the questions of each family. Unlearnable families (PRNG, pi) should sit at their base rate, near 0.5.

panels.title: Held-out BCE per family (nats; dashed = logistic baseline)
panels.description: Cross-entropy per family on held-out (or prequential) data; red dashed line at ln 2 = always 0.5. Thin dashed lines: a per-question logistic model on the same inputs.

panels.title: Brier score per family (0.25 = always 0.5)
panels.description: Mean (p - y)^2 per family on held-out (or prequential) data. Lower is better.
